body_markdown:
Convenient Public Storage options in Miami include 91 SW 3rd St and 151 NW 5th Street downtown, 2190 SW 8th St in Little Havana and 760 NW 21st St near Allapattah and Wynwood. These locations connect with major city routes including I-95, State Road 836, Biscayne Boulevard and Southwest 8th Street.


The most convenient choice depends on your neighborhood, daily route and preferred access hours. Whether you are moving, decluttering or making room at home, compare the specific facility and unit before reserving.


## What Public Storage Options Are Available in Miami?


Public Storage has 76 facilities in Miami and nearby communities. Climate-controlled storage is available at 65 facilities, while 31 offer car storage. Available spaces range from lockers to 10×30 units.


Common unit sizes are available throughout the area:

Monthly prices start at $11, and the average monthly unit price is $132. Prices, promotions, features and availability vary by location and can change.


## Convenient Self-Storage in Miami: 91 SW 3rd St


Public Storage at[91 SW 3rd St](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-fl-miami/5314.html) is in downtown Miami near the Miami River, Brickell and I-95.


The facility offers indoor, climate-controlled storage in small, medium and large sizes. Standard property access is currently available from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. daily, and 24/7 Access is available for eligible customers.


**Why it’s convenient:** The Southwest 3rd Street location provides a central option for customers who live or work downtown or in Brickell. Its proximity to I-95 can also make it practical for customers traveling from other parts of Miami.


## Where Else Can You Find Convenient Self-Storage in Miami?


Miami traffic and river crossings can add time to a short trip. A facility in your neighborhood or on the same side of downtown as your regular route may be easier to use.


### Downtown Near Bayside


Public Storage at[151 NW 5th Street](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-fl-miami/485.html) is in downtown Miami near Bayside Marketplace, Bayfront Park and Maurice A. Ferré Park.


The facility offers indoor, climate-controlled storage in small, medium and large sizes. Access is currently available from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. Monday through Friday and from 6 a.m. to 5 p.m. Saturday and Sunday.


**Why it’s convenient:** This location may suit customers in downtown Miami, Park West and nearby neighborhoods who want a central indoor storage option close to Biscayne Boulevard.


### Little Havana on Southwest 8th Street


Public Storage at[2190 SW 8th St](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-fl-miami/5316.html) is in Little Havana at Southwest 8th Street and 22nd Avenue along the Calle Ocho corridor.


**Why it’s convenient:** The Southwest 8th Street location can work well for customers in Little Havana, Coral Way and nearby neighborhoods or anyone who regularly travels along Calle Ocho.


### Near Allapattah and Wynwood


Public Storage at[760 NW 21st St](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-fl-miami/6282.html) provides an option near Allapattah, Wynwood and the Northwest 20th Street corridor.


The facility offers indoor, climate-controlled storage in small, medium and large sizes. Property access is currently available from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. daily.


**Why it’s convenient:** This location may fit customers in Allapattah, Wynwood and nearby neighborhoods who want storage north of downtown with evening access during the facility’s current schedule.


## What Makes a Self-Storage Facility Convenient in Miami?


In Miami, neighborhood traffic, river crossings and the time you plan to visit can all affect convenience.


When comparing Miami storage facilities, consider:


- **Neighborhood:** A facility near downtown, Brickell, Little Havana, Allapattah or another area already in your routine can reduce extra travel.
- **Major routes:** Look for connections to I-95, State Road 836, Biscayne Boulevard, Southwest 8th Street or another road you use often.
- **Access hours:** The featured facilities have different closing times, so compare the schedule with when you expect to visit.
- [Climate-controlled storage in Miami](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-fl-miami/climate-controlled-storage-units) **:** Miami’s heat and humidity may make this feature worth considering for some belongings. These units are designed to help maintain more consistent temperature and humidity levels than non-climate-controlled storage.
- **Indoor access:** The four featured facilities offer indoor units. Review the loading area, elevator access and route to the exact space.
- [Vehicle storage in Miami](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-fl-miami/car-storage-units) **:** Car, boat, RV and motorcycle storage is available at select Miami-area facilities.
- **Unit size:** Choose enough room for your belongings and a path to items you expect to retrieve.


## Which Storage Unit Size Should You Choose?


Choose a unit based on what you plan to store and how much access room you need.


- A **5×5 unit** can hold boxes, seasonal decorations and smaller household items.
- A **5×10 unit** can accommodate the contents of one room, including some furniture.
- A **10×10 unit** offers space for furnishings and boxes from several rooms.
- A **10×20 unit** can support a larger move or home project involving multiple rooms.


Actual dimensions and capacities vary. Use the[Public Storage Size Guide](https://www.publicstorage.com/size-guide) and review the specific unit before renting when possible.


## How Do You Choose the Most Convenient Storage Facility in Miami?


Start with the neighborhood and route you already use. The Southwest 3rd Street and Northwest 5th Street facilities provide downtown options with different access schedules. Southwest 8th Street may be easier for customers in Little Havana, while Northwest 21st Street can fit an Allapattah or Wynwood routine.


Then compare access hours, unit size and property features. If you need climate-controlled storage, Drive-Up Access, vehicle storage or 24/7 Access, confirm availability for the exact facility and unit before reserving.


## Frequently Asked Questions About Self-Storage in Miami


### How many Public Storage facilities are in the Miami area?


Public Storage has 76 facilities in Miami and nearby communities. Facility counts and availability can change.


### Where can I find Public Storage in downtown Miami?


Featured downtown options include 91 SW 3rd St near the Miami River and Brickell and 151 NW 5th Street near Bayside Marketplace and Bayfront Park.


### Can I find climate-controlled storage in Miami?


Yes. Climate-controlled storage is available at 65 Miami-area facilities, including all four featured locations.


### Is car storage available in Miami?


Yes. Car storage is available at 31 area facilities. Space type, dimensions and availability vary by location.


### Does Public Storage offer 24/7 Access in Miami?


Select locations offer 24/7 Access. The featured facility at 91 SW 3rd St currently lists this option for eligible customers. Availability and requirements vary.


### Which featured Miami locations have later standard access hours?


The facilities at 91 SW 3rd St and 760 NW 21st St currently list standard access until 9 p.m. daily. The other two featured locations currently close at 6 p.m. on weekdays and 5 p.m. on weekends.


### How much does a storage unit cost in Miami?


Monthly prices start at $11, and the average monthly unit price is $132. Your price will depend on the location, size, features, promotion and current availability.


### How can I find a Public Storage facility near me in Miami?


Search by your address, neighborhood or ZIP code on the[Miami Public Storage page](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-fl-miami) . Compare each facility’s route, access hours and available unit features.


## Find Convenient Self-Storage in Miami


Public Storage offers options in downtown Miami, Little Havana, Allapattah, Wynwood and throughout the surrounding area. Choose a location that fits your neighborhood and routine, then confirm the unit size, access hours and features before reserving.
